title: PHPMailer mailSend() remote code execution (CVE-2016-10033)
description: The mailSend function in PHPMailer before 5.2.18 allows remote code execution via a crafted From address that is passed to a shell command (sendmail -f).

title: PHPMailer sender injection / code execution (CVE-2016-10045)
description: PHPMailer before 5.2.20 does not properly validate sender addresses, allowing code execution via crafted input in sendmail parameters.

title: PHPUnit eval() remote code execution (CVE-2017-9841)
description: PHPUnit before 4.8.28 ships Util/PHP/eval-stdin.php which evaluates php://input as PHP code, allowing remote code execution if the file is web-accessible.

title: PHPUnit eval() remote code execution (CVE-2017-9841)
description: PHPUnit 5.x before 5.6.3 ships Util/PHP/eval-stdin.php which evaluates php://input as PHP code.

title: Dompdf arbitrary file write / RCE via font cache (CVE-2022-41343)
description: dompdf before 2.0.1 allows remote code execution via a crafted font cache path and PHP file extension (.php) in the font cache.

title: Guzzle information disclosure via CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER (CVE-2022-31090)
description: Guzzle 7.x before 7.4.5 mishandles the Cookie and Authorization headers via CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, potentially leaking credentials across redirects.

title: guzzlehttp/psr7 improper header validation (CVE-2023-29197)
description: guzzlehttp/psr7 before 2.4.5 does not strip CR/LF from header names, allowing HTTP response splitting / header injection.

title: Laravel remote code execution via unserialize() (CVE-2018-15133)
description: Laravel before 5.6.30 deserializes the X-XSRF-TOKEN cookie via unserialize(), enabling remote code execution through POP chains.

title: Ignition (Laravel) remote code execution (CVE-2021-3129)
description: Ignition before 2.5.2 allows unauthenticated remote code execution via a crafted request to the debug error page.

title: Symfony remote code execution via unserialize() (CVE-2018-19790)
description: Symfony before 3.4.20 is vulnerable to PHP object injection / RCE through crafted serialized data in the routing/cache subsystem.
